Build a TTE / TTNI summary table

Source: R/build_ttni_table.R
build_ttni_table.Rd

Uses tern Kaplan-Meier layout functions for both multi-arm (dose-level) and two-arm designs. Hazard ratio, 95% CI, and log-rank p-value are added only when exactly two arms are present.

Usage

build_ttni_table(
  adsl = NULL,
  adtte = NULL,
  arm_var = "TRT01A",
  ref_arm = NULL,
  paramcd = "TTNI",
  timepoints = c(3, 6, 12, 18, 24),
  show_total = NULL,
  include_followup = TRUE,
  surv_stats = NULL,
  landmark_style = c("detailed", "rate_only"),
  conf_type = c("log-log", "log", "plain"),
  conf_level = 0.95,
  compute_hr = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  footnotes = NULL,
  prepped = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

adsl

ADSL or combined TTE data. Ignored when prepped is supplied.

adtte

Optional ADTTE data frame.

arm_var

Treatment / grouping variable.

ref_arm

Reference arm used for two-arm HR calculations.

paramcd

Analysis parameter code.

timepoints

Landmark months.

show_total

Whether to add a Total column. Defaults to TRUE for multi-arm designs and FALSE for two-arm designs.

include_followup

Whether to include reverse KM follow-up time.

surv_stats

Time-to-event statistics from ttni_surv_time_choices(). NULL uses default_ttni_surv_stats(). mean_sd is a descriptive Mean (SD) of AVAL; the rest are tern::surv_time() statistics. Legacy median / median_ci requests are folded into one median_ci_3d row. The same selection is used for follow-up time when include_followup is TRUE.

landmark_style

"detailed" includes patients remaining at risk; "rate_only" shows rate (95% CI) only.

conf_type

KM CI type passed to tern::control_surv_time().

conf_level

Confidence level.

compute_hr

NULL to auto-detect (two-arm only), or a flag. A request of TRUE on a multi-arm data set is ignored with a warning.

title

Table title. NULL derives a title from paramcd.

footnotes

Optional method footnotes. NULL (default) omits them so the interactive table stays compact; definitions live in the README. Pass default_ttni_footnotes() when a TFL-style footer is required.

prepped

Optional list from prep_ttni_data(). When supplied, raw adsl / adtte are not re-prepared.

...

Passed to prep_ttni_data() when prepped is NULL.

Value

An rtables VTableTree.

Details

Pass either raw adsl / adtte or a list returned by prep_ttni_data() via prepped so the teal server can prepare data once.

Examples

two_arm <- make_synthetic_ttni_data("two_arm", seed = 1L)
build_ttni_table(two_arm$ADSL, two_arm$ADTTE, ref_arm = "Placebo")

#> Parameter: TTNI
#> Design: two-arm; HR vs Placebo
#>

#>   The initiation of subsequent anticancer therapy       14 (35.0)            14 (35.0)     
#>   Death                                                  1 (2.5)              1 (2.5)      
#> Number of participants censored, n (%)                  25 (62.5)            25 (62.5)     
#>   Last known alive date                                 24 (60.0)            19 (47.5)

build_ttni_table(multi$ADSL, multi$ADTTE, show_total = TRUE)
